description: Header file defining utility functions for numeric operations, including isnan, isinf, exp, log, log1p, and tan, with support for various data types and hardware-specific optimizations.

methods.name: _isnan
methods.description: Checks if a value is NaN, specialized for different types including integral, floating point, complex, and custom types.

methods.name: _isinf
methods.description: Checks if a value is infinite, specialized for different types including integral, floating point, and custom types.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Computes exponential, optimized for float types and using fast approximations on CUDA/HIP architectures.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes natural logarithm, optimized similarly to exp.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Computes log(1 + x), with fast approximation on CUDA/HIP.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Computes tangent, with fast approximation on CUDA/HIP.
